name: ardyn, the usurper
mana cost: {5}{B}{B}{B}
types: legendary creature elder human noble
power toughness: 4/4
triggered: starscourge — at the beginning of combat on your turn, exile up to one target creature card from a graveyard. if you exiled a card this way, create a token that's a copy of that card, except it's a 5/5 black demon.
static: demons you control have menace, lifelink, and haste.
